Meet The Owner

How Fairmont Flooring Started

Fairmont Flooring was established with a clear ambition: to bring high-quality flooring, exceptional workmanship and a professional customer experience to homeowners throughout Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.

Building on our experience within the property improvement industry, we recognised an opportunity to expand into specialist flooring installations and offer customers the same attention to detail, reliability and high standards.

Our vision is to create a flooring company built on quality rather than quantity, specialising in beautiful engineered wood, luxury LVT, herringbone and bespoke flooring solutions. We want every customer to feel confident that their home is in safe hands, from the initial consultation through to the finished installation.

At Fairmont Flooring, we believe that great results come from great people. Our team is focused on delivering professional flooring installations with pride, care and attention to detail. We understand that having work carried out in your home requires trust, which is why we place great importance on being reliable, respectful and keeping our customers informed throughout every stage of the project.

Quality isn't just how a floor looks when it's finished. It's everything that goes into getting it right.

Why Choose Us

What Makes Us Different

What makes Fairmont Flooring different is our commitment to doing things properly.

  1. 01

    We Never Rush the Preparation

    We don't believe in rushing installations, cutting corners or compromising on materials to win work. Every floor starts with proper subfloor preparation.

  2. 02

    Supply and Installation in One

    We offer a complete supply-and-installation service, making the entire process straightforward, from choosing the right floor to the final finishing details. See our services.

  3. 03

    The Small Details

    We take pride in the small details that make a big difference, from perfectly aligned herringbone patterns to beautifully finished borders, thresholds and staircases.

  4. 04

    Quality Rather Than Quantity

    Our vision is a flooring company built on quality rather than quantity, specialising in engineered wood, luxury LVT, herringbone and bespoke flooring.

  5. 05

    12 Months on All Work

    Every floor we fit is covered: we give 12 months on all work.
